what: unblinded analysis of Satella seed-versus-adapter quality ratings

defect_note.note: had some breaking at the end voice cracking

verdict: The shipped Satella configuration is not uniformly broken: it was preferred on two of four lines and scored 5 twice. However, it produced the only explicitly identified cracking failure and averaged 0.50 below the control adapter. Changing only the seed improved the mean by 0.25. At n=4, this supports render/seed sensitivity plus a possible smaller adapter effect; it does not justify declaring either cause sufficient by itself.
